2608.26701.title: Accelerating Scientific Research with Gemini in the Real-World
2608.26701.paper_summary: We present an extension and comprehensive real-world validation of Co-Scientist, a Gemini-based multi-agent system designed to accelerate end-to-end scientific research across hypothesis generation, experimentation, and manuscript generation. Moving beyond in silico hypothesis generation, this specialized configuration transitions Co-Scientist into an execution-grounded research partner advancing closed-loop scientific workflows across materials science, biology, and computer science. In materials science, Co-Scientist interfaced with a semi-automated chemical vapor deposition reactor to design a safe precursor route for MXenes; experimental execution produced a lamellar 2D material sharing key structural similarities with the Ti3C2Tx MXene lattice, although further experiments are needed to confirm the atomic structure. Leveraging Gemini 3 Deep Think for rapid, lab-in-the-loop execution, it also tailored growth recipes to laboratory constraints in minutes, enabling single-attempt growth of monolayer MoS2, MoSe2, and WS2 semiconductors. In biology, Co-Scientist predicted emergent swarming phenotypes of engineered E. coli across inducer (IPTG) gradients from sparse imaging data, quantitatively matching unpublished wet-lab morphological measurements. In computer science, Co-Scientist autonomously discovered an inference-time scaling architecture that outperformed six frontier models on HealthBench (Hard and Professional) while reducing potential clinical harm under blinded physician evaluation. Finally, a double-blind study of end-to-end generated papers with 30 domain experts across 450 reviews demonstrates that Co-Scientist's reliability modules reduce hallucination and plagiarism while improving research safety. Together, these results demonstrate progress toward closed-loop multi-agent scientific AI systems capable of accelerating real-world scientific discovery.
2608.26701.paper_summary_zh: 我們展示了Co-Scientist的擴展和全面的實際驗證，這是一個基於Gemini的多代理系統，旨在加速從假設生成、實驗到手稿生成的端到端科學研究。超越了計算機模擬的假設生成，這一專門配置將Co-Scientist轉變為一個以執行為基礎的研究夥伴，推進材料科學、生物學和計算機科學中的閉環科學工作流程。在材料科學中，Co-Scientist與半自動化的化學氣相沉積反應器進行了接口，以設計MXenes的安全前驅體路徑；實驗執行產生了一種層狀的2D材料，與Ti3C2Tx MXene晶格具有關鍵的結構相似性，儘管還需要進一步的實驗來確認原子結構。利用Gemini 3 Deep Think進行快速的實驗室內執行，它還在幾分鐘內根據實驗室的限制量身定制生長配方，使得單次嘗試能夠生長單層MoS2、MoSe2和WS2半導體。在生物學中，Co-Scientist預測了工程化大腸桿菌在誘導劑（IPTG）梯度下的 emergent swarming 表型，並且從稀疏成像數據中定量匹配了未發表的濕實驗形態測量。在計算機科學中，Co-Scientist自主發現了一種推理時間擴展架構，該架構在HealthBench（Hard和Professional）上超越了六個前沿模型，同時在盲法醫生評估下減少了潛在的臨床傷害。最後，對30位領域專家的450次評審進行的雙盲研究顯示，Co-Scientist的可靠性模塊減少了幻覺和抄襲，同時提高了研究安全性。綜合這些結果顯示，朝著能夠加速現實世界科學發現的閉環多代理科學AI系統邁出了進展。
